Grain size and density test on PS soil; apparatus: sieve analysis and MMDT on bin sample. Recorded: grain size curve; gamma_min and gamma_max.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The measurements of this test have not been digitized yet; the setup and the source pages are indexed. The setup below rests on two agent readings of the report that were reconciled; no person has checked it yet. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, tool, bin or mold, fill depth, control, rate are not reported.
